name: @pipeworx/mcp-shodan-internetdb

tools.name: lookup_ip
tools.description: Look up an IP address in the Shodan InternetDB. Returns open ports, hostnames, known vulnerabilities (CVEs), CPEs (software identifiers), and tags. Free, no API key needed. Example: lookup_ip("8.8.8.8").

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-shodan-internetdb forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the shodan-internetdb pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
